title: The Baer Transform for Skew Braces
summary: We introduce and study the Baer transform for finite skew braces whose additive group has odd order and nilpotency class at most $2$. Starting from Baer's classical construction for nilpotent groups of odd order and nilpotency class $2$, we replace the additive group $(X,+)$ by an abelian group $(X,\oplus)$ on the same underlying set and prove that \[ Br(X)=(X,\oplus,\cdot) \] is a finite skew brace of abelian type.
